cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You and your manager both say my train was cancelled. Give me your account separately; I've an interview to get to.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The signal failed. It's on the public departure board.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a shared source, not independent testimony. Who's operating the board? I'll need their part in this.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The fault's delaying three counties. Nobody's singling you out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it needs a regional investigation. Don't classify this as a local complaint; they've stopped three counties to keep me from that job.
